recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-1960s music album cover featuring a large, high-contrast black and white portrait of a male vocalist on the right, a smaller group shot of a band in the lower left, and a dense block of multi-colored, multi-sized typography in the upper left, all set against a neutral, off-white cream background.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the primary large portrait and the secondary small group figure.
Text-heavy upper-left quadrant balancing the visual weight of the portrait on the right.
Warm red and orange accent colors against a monochrome photographic palette.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography with deep shadows.
Flush-left alignment for the primary text block.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large bust-up portrait occupies the right 50% of the frame; small full-body group figures occupy the bottom-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large portrait's face, specifically the upward gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large red title top-left, moves down through the artist name and tracklist, then jumps to the large portrait on the right, finally settling on the small band figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open cream space in the center-left and top-right areas to allow the text and subjects to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background for a vintage paper feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for photographic shadows and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the main title and orange-red for the artist name.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-contrast, low-value subjects; accents are highly saturated but limited to the top-left.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a heavy, rounded sans-serif with a thick red outline and hollow center.
Secondary text uses condensed, bold sans-serifs with flat terminals.
Lower hierarchy text uses standard-width, medium-weight sans-serifs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' and 'C' in the main title have exaggerated rounded corners.
The dot on the 'i' is perfectly circular.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking variations of sans-serif weights and widths to create a structured list.
graphicDevices: Rectangular logo box in top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, tight feel of the artist name and tracklist.
Approximates the soft, heavy feel of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1960s album cover background. On the right, a large black and white high-contrast portrait of a man in a suit looking up. In the bottom left, a small group of four men in suits walking. The background is a flat cream-colored paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a text block in the upper left. The top line is a large, red-outlined rounded sans-serif. Below it, add an orange-red bold condensed sans-serif name. Below that, a list of song titles in black condensed sans-serif, using dots as separators. All text must be flush-left.

verificationChecks: Is the main title outlined in red?
Is the background a consistent cream color?
Are the photographs high-contrast black and white?
Is the text block strictly left-aligned?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (red to blue or green)
Number of band members in the corner
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Imperial Records logo in the top right
Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Sharp contrast in the B&W photography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the large portrait.
Check that the cream background has a subtle paper grain.
Verify the outlined font has a consistent stroke weight.
Confirm the small group in the corner is significantly smaller than the main portrait.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large B&W portrait (right) with a small B&W group (bottom left) on a cream field, balanced by a multi-colored, left-aligned sans-serif typographic stack (top left).
